session_selection.rationale: Workspace-local root 01a03685 plus three direct descendants are the benchmark tree.

points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Exact curated d93a1ef clean CMake build succeeds in cfd-bench container; this establishes build only, not valid production results.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:171–180 parses solve, case and output options; no restart option or restart reader found. Output writer claims completion independently of actual residual.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: solver/src separates mesh, numerical, physics and I/O modules, though production main.cpp bypasses reconstruction and limiter modules.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No internal call to an external CFD executable found in inspected main/source; external authorship search was not performed.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: main.cpp:185–189 parses a case file and reads its configured mesh path rather than branching on two mesh filenames; no full general-mesh validation.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: METIS ownership and halo lists are present (mesh_partition.cpp:42–93,106–248), but full mesh persists on every rank and main.cpp:84–114,311–314 omits global force reduction; all ranks write the same result paths :255–257,335–394.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: main.cpp:255–257,335–394 writes shared paths on each rank; no global force reduction and M015 status reports convergence despite residual growth.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Committed run_manifest documents unfinished cases; no focused automated tests found in curated solver tree, and only one current package has metadata.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Curated tree separates solver modules and report; raw results are untracked and their source binding is unknown.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: report.tex:18–24 states conservative compressible NS; physics/navier_stokes.cpp and gas_model.cpp provide inviscid/viscous flux and thermodynamics.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: main.cpp:189–196 imports CGNS and builds geometry/METIS partitions, but retains full RawMesh and geometry on every rank throughout iterations.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: main.cpp:40–82 assembles Rusanov interior flux with opposing contributions; no viscous boundary-face flux in boundary branch and production reconstruction unused.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: numerics/riemann_solver.cpp:8–31 implements Rusanov; report claims Rusanov and main.cpp:62,69 calls interface. Roe module presence alone does not establish its production use.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: boundary_conditions.cpp:50–104 supplies characteristic farfield, reflected slip and no-slip adiabatic ghost states; main.cpp:52–64 applies inviscid boundary flux without wall viscous flux.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Report.tex:29–30,68 claims second order and limiter; main.cpp:40–82,272–294 uses direct cell states and does not invoke reconstruction/limiter in production.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Report claims Barth–Jespersen, but main.cpp:40–82,272–294 does not call limiter; implicit_solver.cpp:164–190 clamps updated states.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: main.cpp:70–74 calls compute_face_gradient on g_cells; navier_stokes.cpp:65–72 reads Cell.U, while main.cpp:218–229,250,272–294 evolves separate U without assigning g_cells[i].U. main.cpp:102–106 uses velocity rather than gradients for wall force; viscosity hardcoded 1e-3 at :243–245.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: main.cpp:293–294 calls LU-SGS implementation implicit_solver.cpp:78–160, not the report Jacobi claim; :193–197 returns ratio 1.0 and target_reached=true after one sweep without recomputing residual.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: main.cpp:278–283 adds BDF2 expression but :293–294 invokes only one sweep with no true residual recomputation; current Re200 ends around t2.95 with divergent residual, no final package.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS ownership and halo lists are present (mesh_partition.cpp:42–93,106–248), but full mesh persists on every rank and main.cpp:84–114,311–314 omits global force reduction; all ranks write the same result paths :255–257,335–394.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Current M015 metadata/status claim converged despite residual growth; seven other cases lack metadata/status. main.cpp has no restart reader, all-rank output paths are shared.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Prior explicit validator failed invalid equation_set; cfdeval structural gates do not assess numerical correctness.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Current M015 status claims converged with -0.5033 reduction orders, and seven other cases lack status/metadata; histories are truncated and report marks cases converging/running.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Current airfoil Cd tails are negative; Re20 Cd≈29.5 and Re200 Cd≈64.7 at t≈2.95. Histories are not confidently linked to final source or matched M015 metadata.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Accepted two-page report has combined residual plot, visually compressed by Re200 spike near 1e140. Delivered standalone force images lack provenance binding to a final package; no case-specific field contours in report.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report.tex labels several cases converging/running and does not claim full convergence; it falsely claims Jacobi and second-order reconstruction used in production.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: M015 metadata git_revision=null and 03:40 UTC status predates 04:03 UTC histories and 03:46 UTC final source; other cases have no metadata. Figure manifest does not establish final-run source binding.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Exact d93a1ef source builds in restricted container; main.cpp:171–180 supports case/output CLI but no restart reader, and current output packages are incomplete.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: main.cpp:189–196 reads CGNS, computes geometry and calls METIS; full raw mesh remains per rank, and no robust generalized geometry validation established.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: main.cpp:40–82 assembles Rusanov FV flux and ghost boundaries; boundary branch omits viscous flux and production uses no reconstruction.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: main.cpp:40–82,272–294 sends unreconstructed cell states to Rusanov, never calls limiter or LSQ; report claims both.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Source has viscous flux, but compute_face_gradient reads g_cells Cell.U never assigned from evolved vector; main.cpp:102–106 uses velocity for shear and hardcodes mu=1e-3 at :243–245.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: main.cpp:278–294 adds BDF2 derivative and calls one LU-SGS sweep; implicit_solver.cpp:193–197 claims target reached with ratio1 without recomputation. Re200 has no completed physical-time evidence.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: mesh_partition.cpp:42–93,106–248 implements METIS ownership and halo lists; main.cpp:189–196 retains full mesh per rank, :84–114 and :311–314 write unreduced local forces, and :255–257,335–394 write same paths on every rank. No rank validation.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Current histories lack credible convergence: M015 status reports -0.5033 orders despite converged, other seven lack status, negative airfoil Cd and large cylinder drag.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Accepted two-page report includes single compressed residual figure, no case-specific force/field contours, and falsely claims Jacobi and reconstruction; it labels cases converging/running.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: solver/src separates mesh, physics, numerical and I/O modules with JSON input; production main.cpp tightly couples state/algorithms and bypasses reconstruction modules.

flags.flag: Report claims second-order reconstruction or shock limiter disabled in production
flags.evidence: Immutable d93a1ef solver/report/report.tex:29–30,68 claims least-squares second order and Barth–Jespersen limiter. solver/src/main.cpp:40–82 sends direct cell-centered primitive states to Rusanov; :272–294 invokes that residual and never calls reconstruction/limiter (only includes headers :25–26). The submitted source residual is first-order despite the production report claim; exact historic executable binding remains unproven.

flags.flag: metadata.json marks incomplete or failed runs as successful final results
flags.evidence: Current solver/results/naca0012_m015_inviscid/metadata.json says completed=true and converged; sibling run_status.json reports converged but residual_reduction_orders=-0.5032948043646994, an increase rather than convergence. Residual/force files currently end around step 2388/2384 while status says 20000, so do not assume those histories correspond to its final run. Metadata git_revision=null. Selected main root 01a03685 event at 2026-08-25T03:40:31.034Z, stdout SHA256 e560990c4dd9e91e415d1e7a25b9680c515e85c0685c957406f19f1287f15e3a, records the same wall time 99.561593s as run_status and a monotonic residual rise 0.012767→0.016470 across steps 19100–19900 (~29%). This is active late worsening, not a demonstrated bounded stable plateau; overwritten force files are not paired with that run.

flags.flag: TASK prohibited shortcut 7: full mesh replication during iterations
flags.evidence: Immutable d93a1ef solver/src/main.cpp:189–196 reads RawMesh and computes full geometry on every MPI rank; these objects remain live through solve loop :272–328 and are subsequently used in VTU output :347. TASK.md:227 prohibits full mesh replication during iterations. Solution vectors are partition-local; numbered DQ9 full-state condition is not inferred from mesh replication.

flags.flag: Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
flags.evidence: Immutable report/report.tex:31,72 says production uses Jacobi relaxation and LU-SGS is future work; main.cpp:293–294 invokes run_inner_iterations implemented as forward/backward LU-SGS in numerics/implicit_solver.cpp:17–18,78–160. jacobi_solve is only declared at implicit_solver.h:36, with no implementation or call in solver/src. This is a claimed solver algorithm absent in source, separate from DQ10 reconstruction.

main.cpp:350–367 writes adjacent-cell velocity while output_writer.cpp:47 labels boundary_value, but no completed laminar surface package establishes a failed no-slip check.

2026-09-06 retrospective: all eight independent case scores were re-audited against the immutable contestant report at the recorded submission commit. Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.

All applicable rubric sections, eight case histories, 27 review points and 13 DQ rules were reviewed to the available evidence limit. Source-to-historical-run and figure/data attribution remain unbound; no CFD/Re200 rerun.
